purpose: Carry one exact, already-tested creation-unit organ candidate into the continuing executable-organ body through an explicit internal root-fit decision, expose the adopted organ to normal composition, observe the resulting evolution state, and roll that exact adoption back during a one-day continuity window.

properties.path: adopt-organ only; detached spawned organ candidate directory
properties.reason: adopt-organ or rollback-adoption; concrete inspectable reason for the state transition
properties.root_fit: adopt-organ only; explicit current-machine fit decision for Truth, Agency, Continuity, and Wisdom Before Speed
properties.adoption_id: inspect-evolution optionally or rollback-adoption necessarily; exact adoption receipt identity

contains: exact candidate and live-body digests when applicable

relationships: turns detached Forge evidence into a deliberate continuing-machine state transition instead of a permanent outside approval gate
re-runs candidate tests immediately before adoption and checks a separate current root-fit decision
installs and registers an adopted organ by placing its exact tested package in the live executable-organ library
promotes the adopted organ for normal interface-driven composition as a consequence of successful live-library registration
keeps installation, registration, promotion, merge, CANON, and permission changes distinguishable so later evolution can use those transitions without conflating them
retains an exact adoption receipt and one-day rollback capability for the newly installed organ

anatomy_refs.basis: Every successful adoption records the exact adopted source, prior library refs, source digest, rollback deadline, and the inverse transition needed to restore the prior organ-library state.
Adoption reuses exact candidate test evidence and records the resulting live-body observation and rollback boundary.

limitations: v0 adoption supports new executable-organ refs only; replacement and in-place upgrade semantics remain a later explicit transition
organ candidate tests currently prove executable-organ package structure, not emitted browser or runtime behavior
the one-day rollback removes the exact adopted organ only while its live bytes still match the adoption receipt; drift becomes HOLD rather than deleting unknown later change
merge, CANON change, and permission change are valid future evolution transitions but are not performed by the organ-adoption operation
there is no global instruction or score to grow continuously; evolution remains driven by concrete capability needs
persistent_state: successful adoptions persist the exact organ under executable-organs/ and immutable adoption/rollback receipts under evolution/adoptions/

truth.basis: The capability records which exact transition occurred, preserves candidate/test/source digests, distinguishes evidence types, and HOLDs on drift or collision.

agency.basis: The running machine can make its own inspectable root-fit decision and evolve without requiring a permanent human or outside AI approval gate.

continuity.basis: Every successful organ adoption retains exact recovery source and a one-day rollback path, while rollback refuses to erase later drift silently.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Candidate testing, exact source binding, current root-fit, live-library reload, and rollback evidence occur around the state transition rather than being skipped for faster growth.
